title: Samuel Thompson
repository: Delaware Native American Archives / Mitsawokett Collection
transcriber: Archival Transcriber / Written in the Genome
citation: "Samuel Thompson." Historical Document Record (2006). Preserved in the Nanticoke & Moor Historical Archive (Written in the Genome Collection).
lines: Funeral program cover: 'Remembering Samuel Thompson - Sunrise September 27, 1930 - Sunset April 11, 2006 - junior.' Photograph of Samuel Thompson leaning on a car. His archive profile records his birth as September 22, 1929 in Newark, Delaware, citing Delaware vital records; the program's birth date and place differ and the conflict is flagged, not resolved. Program photographed and supplied by Jequan Davis, 2026-11-23.
